newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli helicopters rocket south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli helicopters rocket south Lebanon.

text.p: Two Israeli helicopters fired rockets at suspected Hizbollah targets in south Lebanon on Thursday night, Lebanese security sources said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air attack, the 41st on Lebanon this year.
The sources said helicopters fired a total of five rockets into the Nabe'al-Tasseh area of the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge, north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
Hizbollah said its guerrillas fired machineguns and rocket propelled grenades at a group of Israeli soldiers trying to infiltrate outside the zone in the direction of Nabe' al-Tasseh.
There was no immediate confirmation of the Hizbollah attack from pro-Israeli militia sources inside the occupation zone.
The pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas are fighting Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine mile)-wide occupation zone.
